editorial.blurb: Giant is an unforgettable neighborhood gem where bold, balanced flavors and pristine seafood shine in an intimate setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Book ahead—the 50-seat dining room fills quickly. Request the chef's counter (4 seats) for a view of the kitchen action, or visit in summer for the patio. Ask your server for dish details; the menu is intentionally mysterious and meant to surprise.
